title: InnoDB Buffer Pool Configuration
text: innodb_buffer_pool_size controls the memory used to cache InnoDB table and index data. A buffer pool too small for the working set increases physical reads. Online resizing is supported; size must respect container memory and chunk constraints.

title: Internal Temporary Table Use in MySQL
text: Internal temporary tables can be created for GROUP BY, ORDER BY and other query forms. tmp_table_size limits an individual in-memory internal temporary table. Created_tmp_disk_tables and Created_tmp_tables help diagnose spills. max_heap_table_size also limits user-created MEMORY tables.

title: MySQL Server System Variables: thread_cache_size
text: thread_cache_size controls cached threads for new connections. Compare Connections and Threads_created during a window; a high thread creation rate under connection churn can justify a larger cache.
